title: JEG3 transplantation assay
protocol: Maintain four week old NUDE mice in pathogen-limited conditions.
Inoculate subcutaneously in the back region below the neck with JEG3 cells \(2.5 x 10^6 cells in RPMI\).
Mix JEG3 cells either alone or with different NK subpopulations \((1 x 10^6 in RPMI)\) for inoculation.
Inject the cell mixture subcutaneously with a total volume of 200 μl per mouse.
Give mice Flt1-Fc or CTLA4-Fc as control \(50 μg per mouse; R&D Systems Inc.\).
Re-inject NK cells with or without Flt1-Fc or CTLA4-Fc molecules subcutaneously in the same site on day 10 and 20.
Sacrifice the mice on day 30 to determine tumor weight and size.
Estimate tumor size in square millimeters as the product of two-dimensional measurements \(longest perpendicular length and width\).
Prepare paraffin sections from tumor samples obtained.
Stain sections with anti-Von Willebrand and hematoxylin at 150X original magnifications.
Quantify microscopic vascular area using NIH image software according to the accompanying instructions.
Identify blood vessels based on morphological identification by a pathologist.
Stain endothelial cells with anti-Von Willebrand antibody.
Measure diameters as the minimum axis of the best fit-ellipse to the lumen.
Select 10 images from each experimental subgroup for analysis.
Average measurements from selected images to give a representative vascular area.
Determine all measurements in a blinded manner by two operators.
Repeat measurements on two different occasions.
